chunks: And with this chain of narration, he said: Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) said:

key_terms.الإِيمانِ: Faith; belief in God and religious tenets.
key_terms.الحَياءُ: Modesty, shyness, or humility; a moral virtue.

ai.seo_question: What is the relationship between modesty and faith in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: Imam Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) defines modesty (hayā') as an intrinsic component of faith, a concept deeply rooted in Shia ethical theology where moral character is viewed as the outward manifestation of inner belief. This concise statement underscores the practical implication that true īmān is incomplete without the behavioral discipline of humility, a theme frequently elaborated upon by the Ahl al-Bayt in their teachings on spiritual perfection.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 26-23 According to the same documentation, on the authority of Al-Ridha (s), “
Being shy is due to faith.”
